# Upstream sources

`efficient_kan.py` is unchanged from [Blealtan/efficient-kan](https://github.com/Blealtan/efficient-kan/blob/master/src/efficient_kan/kan.py), retrieved 2026-11-04, Git blob `f27c1b7649e7ada4e329c35a7c14ba677a09cb1d`. MIT license: `efficient-kan-LICENSE`.

`PolynomialNeuron` in ../models.py independently implements the polynomial parameterization and initialization in [NewT123-WM/Task_based_neurons](https://github.com/NewT123-WM/Task_based_neurons/blob/main/utils/nolinear_neuron.py), Git blob `7b738aeb7b71902cdf69fce55e95e3a4cb2cf070`. Adjacent `task-neurons-LICENSE` preserves the upstream MIT notice. Data in neural_data/ is imported from that project's public synthetic HDF5 files; provenance.json records hashes. No original checkout or environment is modified.
